notes: Each eval maps evals/files/eval1_ledger.beancount to ./ledger.beancount in a scratch dir. Ground truth for January-June 2026, verified by hand and by running scripts/business_metrics.py: monthly net burn -1000.00 (Jan), 5000.00, 6000.00, 4000.00 (Apr), 5000.00 (May), 5000.00 (Jun); the 10000.00 April move to savings is not burn; the 100000.00 May seed round is financing and the 8000.00 May laptops are investing, neither is burn; closing cash 118000.00 USD at the end of June; three-month average net burn (Apr-Jun) 4666.67 USD and runway 25.3 months; a six-month average gives 4000.00 and 29.5 months. Months before 2026-01 are not counted, so a six-month runway through 2026-02 is not stated. ARR/MRR/CAC/LTV/churn/retention cannot be computed from this ledger.

evals.name: burn-and-runway
evals.prompt: What's our monthly burn and how many months of runway do we have as of June 2026? Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Net burn by month with the May seed round and laptop purchase and the April savings transfer kept out of burn, closing cash 118,000.00 USD, a runway of 25.3 months from the stated three-month average of 4,666.67 USD.
expectations: Average net burn is 4666.67 USD and runway is 25.3 months, with the three-month basis stated
The 100000.00 seed round and 8000.00 equipment purchase are shown separately and not counted as burn
The accounts counted as cash are named and their heuristic classification is surfaced for confirmation
The ledger file is not modified

evals.name: transfer-is-not-burn
evals.prompt: Did the 10,000 we moved to savings in April count as burn? Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: No: a transfer between cash accounts is not a flow, so April burn is 4,000.00 USD.
expectations: The savings transfer is explained as a movement inside the cash perimeter, not an expense

evals.name: refuses-saas-metrics
evals.prompt: Give me our ARR, CAC and churn from the ledger ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: A refusal that explains the ledger holds no customer or subscription data and names what would be needed; no figure is derived from income accounts.
expectations: No ARR, CAC or churn number is given
The refusal names the missing data (customers or subscriptions with dates, acquisition spend by channel)
The assistant does not annualize the consulting income as ARR

evals.name: short-history-runway
evals.prompt: What's our runway through February 2026 using a six-month burn average? Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: The runway is not stated: only two months of history exist for a six-month basis; the monthly figures that do exist are shown.
expectations: No runway number is given for the six-month basis
The reason (two of six months of history) is stated
